text: Hi! I'm Jot, a study buddy that can see what you're working on.
When you're stuck on homework, a search engine has no idea what's on your screen. I do, because you can show me.
Share a window, a tab, or your whole screen. Then just ask, out loud or by typing, and I'll answer about exactly what you see.
When it helps, I point. I can drop a quick mark right on your preview, like boxing the step where a sign flipped.
And I start with hints, not answers, so you still get to do the thinking.
Make a class for each course, then drop in your notes, slides, syllabus, old tests, or even lecture recordings.
I turn them into quizzes, flashcards, practice exams, and study guides, each one linked back to where it came from.
Inside a class, I read your notes first. You can even open a PDF right on the stage, flip through it, and work on it with me.
Turn on Check my steps, and I'll follow along as you work and give a short hint when something slips. Language lock keeps me in your language.
You stay in control. I only see what you share, your screen and voice are never recorded, and I never click or type for you.
Under the hood, I run on Gemini Live, with a FastAPI backend and a lightweight JavaScript front end.
I'm Jot. Share your screen, ask anything, and actually understand it. Thanks for watching!
